units.summary: Retrieval: List four things about Rosie from this part of the source.
units.difficulty_basis: 4 marks, retrieve four explicit facts from a short extract (AO1)

units.summary: Language: How does the writer use language here to describe the garden?
units.difficulty_basis: 8 marks, analyse the writer's language in a printed extract (AO2)

units.summary: Structure: How has the writer structured the text to interest you as a reader?
units.difficulty_basis: 8 marks, analyse structure across the whole source (AO2)

units.summary: Evaluation: To what extent do you agree?
units.difficulty_basis: 20 mark critical evaluation of a statement, using language and structure as evidence (AO4)

units.summary: Writing: Write a description of a mysterious place, as suggested by this picture
units.difficulty_basis: 40 marks, extended descriptive or narrative writing (24 content and organisation, 16 technical accuracy; AO5, AO6)
